documents.doc_pm: {"attrs":{"schemaVersion":1},"content":[{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-0ab22a46b63fa632","level":1},"content":[{"text":"接入 DeepSeek：三分钟拿到你的 API Key","type":"text"}],"type":"heading"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-35bde49a56567856"},"content":[{"text":"青简自己不收 AI 使用费——写作、审查、衍生稿消耗的模型额度,走的都是你自己的 DeepSeek 账户,用多少付多少,账单透明。所以第一次使用前,需要花两三分钟把自己的 API Key 接进来。跟着下面的截图走,全程不会超过五分钟。","type":"text"}],"type":"paragraph"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-dd018da89294f624","level":2},"content":[{"text":"一、登录 DeepSeek 开放平台","type":"text"}],"type":"heading"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-06739449509e3c15"},"content":[{"text":"打开 platform.deepseek.com,用手机号验证码或微信扫码即可登录——没注册过也不用单独注册,未注册的手机号会自动完成注册。","type":"text"}],"type":"paragraph"},{"attrs":{"align":"center","alt":"DeepSeek 开放平台登录页","blockId":"block-eeb148c6d790f512","src":"/api/v1/files/8c22c7ba-79a0-4f0b-a1b5-c2ba8463611b/ds-signin.webp"},"type":"image"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-1f7325442df20cb8"},"content":[{"text":"图注:DeepSeek 开放平台登录页:手机号验证码或微信扫码,未注册自动注册","type":"text"}],"type":"paragraph"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-edddbf37ed6491a3","level":2},"content":[{"text":"二、创建一把 API Key","type":"text"}],"type":"heading"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-8054bfffac104f5b"},"content":[{"text":"登录后看左侧菜单,点「API keys」进入密钥管理页,再点右上角的「创建 API key」。","type":"text"}],"type":"paragraph"},{"attrs":{"align":"center","alt":"API keys 密钥管理页","blockId":"block-90468cbafa81a6f6","src":"/api/v1/files/272119de-5179-45c9-b17f-a06640f12265/ds-apikeys.webp"},"type":"image"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-d8e6da0b896ee337"},"content":[{"text":"图注:左侧菜单进「API keys」,右上角就是「创建 API key」按钮","type":"text"}],"type":"paragraph"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-227772d9cd34cded"},"content":[{"text":"给这把 Key 起个名字,比如 qingjian,点「创建」。","type":"text"}],"type":"paragraph"},{"attrs":{"align":"center","alt":"创建 API key 命名","blockId":"block-d9bd4df7cde681eb","src":"/api/v1/files/f2a9257a-e486-46d3-a237-e9256cd4cd30/ds-create-name.webp"},"type":"image"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-059803ab401d62a7"},"content":[{"text":"图注:起个好认的名字,方便日后在列表里对账","type":"text"}],"type":"paragraph"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-001735e8ce887fb4","level":2},"content":[{"text":"三、立刻复制,妥善保存","type":"text"}],"type":"heading"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-2a3e6ed5b5afec61"},"content":[{"text":"创建成功后会弹出完整的 Key(一串 sk- 开头的字符)。这是它唯一一次完整显示——点「复制」马上存好,关掉弹窗后就再也看不到了。如果忘了复制也不要紧,删掉这把重新创建一把即可。","type":"text"}],"type":"paragraph"},{"attrs":{"align":"center","alt":"创建成功显示完整 Key","blockId":"block-213db71a7783450e","src":"/api/v1/files/81222af9-8543-4aa3-a72c-8c4ebcb179c1/ds-created-copy.webp"},"type":"image"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-336f330b947d0daf"},"content":[{"text":"图注:Key 只在创建时完整显示一次,点「复制」立刻保存","type":"text"}],"type":"paragraph"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-ec9d53725472b5a6"},"content":[{"text":"另外记住平台的忠告:不要把 Key 分享给别人,也不要贴到公开的网页或代码仓库里——DeepSeek 发现泄露的 Key 会自动禁用。","type":"text"}],"type":"paragraph"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-01a16aa9ffdd3105","level":2},"content":[{"text":"四、充一点余额","type":"text"}],"type":"heading"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-91e39979509b72ed"},"content":[{"text":"左侧菜单进「充值」。不用多,10 元就足够写很久——青简的常规一轮生成加审查通常只花几分钱。支付宝、微信都行。","type":"text"}],"type":"paragraph"},{"attrs":{"align":"center","alt":"充值页面","blockId":"block-1a74ed7805cff90c","src":"/api/v1/files/45895bdb-1d4b-4db6-8767-5292259b750c/ds-topup.webp"},"type":"image"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-4af7cc386a5f19cc"},"content":[{"text":"图注:充值页:10 元起充,支付宝 / 微信支付","type":"text"}],"type":"paragraph"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-243f0300b6ce2684"},"content":[{"text":"一个省钱小知识:DeepSeek 自 2026 年 8 月 17 日起执行峰谷定价,北京时间 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00 为高峰时段,其余时间价格减半。早起或夜里写稿,同样的字数只花一半的钱。","type":"text"}],"type":"paragraph"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-ce3b23c9ac51e625","level":2},"content":[{"text":"五、填回青简","type":"text"}],"type":"heading"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-b8dbae22986d3986"},"content":[{"text":"拿着刚复制的 Key 回到青简:如果是第一次启动,青简会直接展示「模型 API 配置」页——把 Key 粘进输入框,自动验证通过、看到「✓ 密钥可用」和余额后点「开始使用」即可。如果当时点了「先跳过」,从首页右上角的齿轮进设置,在「模型」面板的 DeepSeek 卡片里点「配置」,粘贴 Key、测试连接、保存。","type":"text"}],"type":"paragraph"},{"attrs":{"blockId":"block-937c807d563780a1"},"content":[{"text":"一件值得放心的事:Key 只保存在你本机,青简用它直接向 DeepSeek 发起请求,不会上传到任何第三方服务器。","type":"text"}],"type":"paragraph"}],"type":"doc"}
